preconditions.description: Input k is an integer between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(line.strip() in ['N', 'Y'] * n for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: Each entry in the adjacency matrix is either 'N' or 'Y'.
The first line of output is an integer n (2 ≤ n ≤ 1000) representing the number of vertices.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.splitlines()[i][j] == stdout.splitlines()[j][i] for i in range(n) for j in range(n))
postconditions.description: The adjacency matrix is symmetric (undirected graph).
The adjacency matrix has no self-loops (G_ii = 'N').

postconditions.expression: any('Y' in line for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]) and any('Y' in stdout.splitlines()[0][1:])
postconditions.description: There exists at least one path between vertex 1 and vertex 2.
The number of shortest paths between vertex 1 and vertex 2 in the output graph equals the input k.
